notes.title: FIXER at PGA 2024
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2469440/Martial_Law_Our_Spring/

[h2]Poznan Game Arena 2024[/h2]

Hi there 🚀 We have hot news for you from Poznań Game Arena 2024! Our team presented the game Martial Law: Our Spring in Hall 7, in the Indie Zone. But this was no ordinary booth - it was a real trip to the past!

[h2]A Polish People's Republic atmosphere[/h2]

Our stand styled as a room from the communist era drew in not only us, but also the visitors! We had everything you need to feel like you were in the old days: a couch, a tiled cooker and a game displayed on a retro Unitra Helios TC 500 TV. Yes, you can hear right - we showed our demos on this thing! 

[img]https://storage.fixer.group/local-media/images/462546334_1359355381692366_9218739570389336817_.original.jpg[/img]

[h2]Feedback and Joy[/h2]

We gathered a lot of interesting feedback from our testers (kudos to all those who ventured out!). Special thanks to those who commented on the... squeaky CRT. Yes, we know it can be annoying, but we treat it with humour! Thanks for all the feedback - it's been invaluable to us.

[img]https://storage.fixer.group/local-media/images/462576279_1495976351060962_3574877774117016731_.original.jpg[/img]

[h2]Award[/h2]

We can't miss the wonderful moment when MTP honoured us with a statuette in the Best Indie Booth category ! It was a huge accolade for us, and now we have a beautiful memento to remind us of this event.

[img]https://storage.fixer.group/local-media/images/IMG_20241027_171324.original.jpg[/img]

[h2]What's Next[/h2]

The full demo of Martial Law: Our Spring will be available at the upcoming Steam Next Fest, so don't miss out! And now, take a look at some photos from our stand - we hope you can feel that PRL vibe with us!


Thanks for being with us at PGA 2024! See you all on Steam! 

PS: As you could see, the cat and the bench mate are back.

notes.title: Ladies and gentlemen, Martial Law: Our Spring
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2469440/

So the day has come, we show that the Martial Law series is alive. The new part will be subtitled [b]Our Spring[/b]. This is a reference to "Zima wasza, wiosna nasza" (Your winter, Our spring), a slogan that appeared during the imposition of martial law in Poland. The slogan expressed the hope that the people in power would take up the battle declared to them after winter subsided (martial law was imposed on December 13, 1981), during which it was difficult to organize demonstrations and strikes.


[h2]Q&A[/h2]

Q: [b]Is this what the final game will look like?[/b]
A: No, these are screenshots from the pre-alpha version. We are constantly working on lighting and textures. As the game develops, we will present revised screenshots.

Q: [b]Did the debating mate survive the winter?[/b]
A: Yes *hick*.

Q: [b]The game will now have an open world?[/b]
A: Let's say, as much as possible under martial law. There will be a main story line all the time, but there will be more side activities. We have also increased the number of hours of gameplay several times. Yes, we know that 0h of Martial Law times x, is further 0 ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°).

[i][b]HIT, THERE WILL BE A MOONSHINE BREWING[/b][/i]

Q: [b]Have the dialogues been improved?[/b]
A: The previous dialogue creator was banned from wasting ink in the keyboard, he is currently engaged in combing Janina's cat. 

Q: [b]Will the game be free?[/b]
A: We are trying to raise the standard of the game, in every possible way, so this part of the game will not be free. But we promise that the price will be fair, and it will be cheaper than the average indie game that is coming out now.

Q: [b]How is Janina's cat doing?[/b]
A: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41003937/c5491dd5b935025dfce1136d879224d6dc30ca5c.gif[/img]

Q: [b]WHEN THE TRAILER !!!11!!!11[/b]
A: When we finish the soundtrack for it.

Q: [b]When is the demo?[/b]
A: On some upcoming Steam Next, but probably the end of this year.

notes.title: We're alive and have a surprise
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41003937/34baa5850b82700e3181bc1f1c8d8f792037a27d.gif[/img]

We won't be asking you for nominations in the [i]Labor of Love[/i] category this year (unless, of course, you want ːDogefaceː), buuut we have some news for you.

[h3]Martial Law on Android and iOS[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41003937/564887cbcd924b98e915d2cf036e4ecb2220ce96.jpg[/img]

Martial Law will be coming out on smartphones in the next few weeks. Of course, at the [i]same price[/i] as for PCs. The game has been optimized and adapted to play it in the weirdest places you can imagine (pls, send us pictures on discord). Unfortunately, the dialogues were left untouched... buuuut

[h3]Martial Law II[/h3]

The Martial Law II project is alive. We will present it to you with the official announcement (with date) of the smartphone port. 
Relative to the previous part, we promise an improved storyline and dialogues. The game will also be longer than the first part (several hours of gameplay for sure). 

PS: There will be a love story with Zofia, as promised.

[h3]Project BP[/h3]

80s, summer, Miami... but about this next time.

~FIXER Group Devs

notes.title: Thank you & Steam Awards
notes.content:
[h2]Hello there[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41003937/c5491dd5b935025dfce1136d879224d6dc30ca5c.gif[/img]
[previewyoutube=6zziuma8D2U;full][/previewyoutube]

From this place we would like to thank you for this year, minus one month, minus one day. During this period of time, the game was [i]purchased at a very special price [/i]by over [b]400k[/b] (Steam, GOG & Xbox). You wrote nearly [b]2k reviews[/b] on Steam (Update: Over 2k already, wow). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41003937/26016e2c3a0b1f0af44854dbd7e33d1814f9cfc1.png[/img]

Martial Law has been localized into [b]7 languages[/b], whereas at the very beginning we thought of 2. We want to thank all the people who were involved in translating the game. You are the best ːpimpheartː

The game was [b]verified on Steam Deck[/b]. From then on, you could play Martial Law in the most important place:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41003937/5ecb3a9566d4e40e93498f423ca541f860f49c69.png[/img]

We just happened not to have Steam Deck when this photo was taken. Assume it's Steam Deck.
([strike]Yes, a port of Martial Law for the Nintendo Switch exists[/strike] [i]We don't know about any port ːDogefaceː[/i])

We would like to thank you by creating the best love story, between Stanisław and Zofia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41003937/ef3836d6cf65a64311ae57835cb9e951e22dd97f.png[/img]

BTW, How creepy she looks

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41003937/dbe059d61b670c7707e0f3af6cd47b2ec283503d.png[/img]

Anyway, the most ardent love story fans have been asking about DLC/mods:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41003937/4d5d2e2d7fbf4e113bef08cbcc09ede911925f83.png[/img]

[i]Maybe one day...[/i]

Summarizing all of the above, [b]thank you very much[/b]. We never expected such a response for [i]a simple game created for Game Jam[/i].

[h2][b]Another thing...[/b][/h2]

The nominations for the Steam Awards have just started. We know that a lot of great games have been developed over the past year. We don't even hope to win. However, you can vote for us in the [b]Outstanding Visual Style[/b] category if you wish. We don't know if the time of communism in Poland was outstanding visually ːfeelingː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41003937/6e23f7120e69f24210415224b58d71803a27cda3.jpg[/img]
[i](by Pixabay/Arcaion)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41003937/385e883e232b4f8276bd5a12fd954a9ad76e3687.png[/img]

[h2]Have a nice day c:[/h2]

[i]~FIXER devs[/i]

[spoiler]What's next? We're staying in the 1980s, but we're changing the location to Florida. We want to make a game that isn't serious. Martial Law will return, but a little later.
[/spoiler]
